title: Seren Nova
description:
TAKE FLIGHT WITH NOVA FORCESeren Nova is a top-down retro 3D space shooter with different mission types, two playable ships, live-action FMV cutscenes and a puppet robot.

The Seren Solar System is under attack. Join Nova Force pilot Aderyn as she fights to protect her home planet, Brython, across six different levels.

Destroy enemy forces, recover stolen technology, rescue hostages and transport objects using your ship’s tractor magnet. Choose between the fast fighter with rapid lasers or the heavier bomber armed with powerful missiles.

 Featuring either mouse and keyboard controls or twin-stick gamepad controls.

CHOOSE YOUR SHIPBefore each mission, choose one of two Nova Force ships.

The fighter is fast and agile, with rapid-firing lasers that are useful for getting in and out of danger quickly.

The bomber is slower but stronger, with powerful missiles that can cause heavy damage.

Both ships have a tractor magnet that can lift, carry and drop objects around the level.

SIX DIFFERENT MISSIONSEach of the six levels has a different location and objective.

You will be asked to search for and destroy enemy targets, recover stolen technology, rescue hostages and carry important objects through dangerous areas.

The tractor magnet can also be used to pick up bombs and drop them onto enemies.

A LIVE-ACTION SCI-FI STORYBetween missions, follow Aderyn’s story through homemade live-action FMV cutscenes inspired by low-budget science-fiction television.

Aderyn may be Nova Force’s best pilot, but protecting billions of lives is difficult enough without Robo, her irritating puppet robot sidekick, getting involved.

FEATURES• Top-down retro 3D space combat

• Six different levels and locations

• Two ships with different weapons and abilities

• Combat, recovery, transport and rescue missions

• A tractor magnet used to carry and drop objects

• Live-action FMV cutscenes

• A cast of actors and a puppet robot

• Extra lore about the Seren Solar System in the game menu

JOIN NOVA FORCE AND DEFEND BRYTHON!
description_short: A top-down 3D retro sci-fi space shooter with free-roaming mission maps, mouse-and-keyboard and twin-stick controls, and live-action FMV cutscenes. Shoot, bomb, or pick up and drop explosives on your enemies.
